cohort: 64 women aged 20-40 years, including 34 pregnant women, admitted to Union Hospital, Wuhan, China
finding: Pregnant women with COVID-19 had milder clinical characteristics compared to non-pregnant women and there was no evidence of vertical transmission of COVID-19 to the fetus.
mod_finding: Of the pregnant women with COVID-19, 5 (14.71%) had natural delivery and 18 (52.94%) had cesarean section.
